#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**  

- **[Ximena Giesemann] (Doctoral Candidate, Claremont Graduate University) – [October 21, 2024, 10:11 PM]:**  
- Reported an issue with study #4055 where the app is not collecting Garmin data despite the participant wearing the watch, syncing with the Garmin app, and Avicenna having permission.  
- Requested troubleshooting assistance.  
- *Key quote:* "*It looks like the app is not collecting the Garmin data even though the participant is wearing the watch, it is synced with the Garmin app, and Avicenna has permission to connect with the Garmin app.*"  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Support, Avicenna Research) – [October 21, 2024, after 10:11 PM]:**  
- Acknowledged the issue and requested additional information to troubleshoot.  
- Asked for participant ID, whether the issue is widespread, and how the Garmin data is checked.  
- *Key quote:* "*Can you please share the following information: What's the participant ID? Do you have any other participants in this study? Is this issue widespread?*"
